# 1. Total live triples = ~37.0 M, matching the asserted base count
# 2. The paper's claim of "65.4 million triples after OWL-Horst
#    materialization" is NOT reflected in the live database: SYS_RDF_SCHEMA
#    contains only the default Virtuoso rule sets, no project-specific
#    rule set is bound, and load_data.sql contains no rule_set call or
#    materialization step. OWL-Horst inference is therefore neither
#    forward-chained on load nor backward-chained on query — until a
#    rule set is explicitly bound (see below).
# 3. After binding the ontology graph as a rule set with
#    the same SELECT (COUNT(*) ...) under DEFINE input:inference 'rak'
#    still returns 36 999 338 triples — Virtuoso applies the rule set as
